title: Dr. Chris Mack Toasts the End of Moore's Law at SPIE Advanced Lithography 2014
summary: A brief toast by lithography expert Chris Mack at SPIE Advanced Lithography 2014, humorously declaring the end of Moore's Law. His argument centers on the cost per transistor no longer falling.
why: HN cites it when arguing Moore's Law is really about price per transistor and that this economic trend has stalled.

quote.text: Dr Chris Mack's argument is that Moore's law is about price per transistor.
